criteria.requirement: Citizen of one of the 34 eligible countries listed on the page ('You must be a citizen of one of the 34 eligible countries to be eligible to apply'); the Democratic Republic of the Congo is not on the list.
criteria.applicant: Citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.quote: Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bangladesh, Belarus, Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Egypt, Ethiopia, Georgia, Guatemala, Indonesia, Iraq, Jordan, Kenya, Liberia, Malaysia, Mexico, Moldova, Morocco, Nigeria, Peru, Philippines, Rwanda, Senegal, South Africa, Tanzania, Thailand, Uganda, Ukraine, Uzbekistan, Vietnam, Zambia

funding.conditions: Full tuition fee coverage, paid by SI to the Swedish university each semester (for awarded scholars).
funding.quote: Full tuition fee coverage. The fee is paid directly by SI to your Swedish university each semester.

funding.conditions: Per month, to cover living expenses throughout the study period.
funding.quote: A monthly allowance of SEK 12,000 to cover your living expenses throughout the study period.

funding.conditions: One-time travel grant (SEK 10,000 for scholars from Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova and Ukraine); does not apply to students already living in Sweden.
SI recommends asking the university about insurance for international students.
funding.quote: Our scholarships do not include insurance coverage.

funding.conditions: SI charges nothing for the scholarship application; the University Admissions application fee is paid by the applicant, is not refundable, and its amount is not stated on the SI pages.
funding.quote: We do not charge any application fee to apply for our scholarships. There is, however, an application fee that you need to pay when you apply for programmes via University Admissions.

out_of_pocket: The University Admissions application fee (amount not stated on the SI pages, not refundable) and insurance are not covered; SI states no other amounts.

cycles.window_text: University Admissions application 16 October 2026 to 15 January 2027; SI scholarship portal 8-24 February 2027 (closes 14:59 CET on 24 February); University Admissions results 1 April 2027; SI announcement 22 April 2027.
cycles.quote: The application portal will close at 14:59 CET, 24 February 2027.
